text: Local P4.4 court is complete but release remains fail-closed. Added dedicated HRF and fit JMH workloads with allocation/work budgets and a full 18-row receipt; executable first-level guide whose Scala blocks are extracted exactly from the DMS acceptance scenario; dedicated performance workflow; coverage, focused, compileAll, testAll, docs, benchmark, and machine-report gates. Full local diagnostics now record all six gates pass. Coverage floors: hrf 72.88/63.02, design 72.84/61.16, model 61.53/56.00, fit 77.28/64.69 statement/branch. DMS plus structural hypothesis suites pass JVM and Scala.js; typed domain-id overloads now use the same idiomatic DSL names via @targetName instead of *Id suffixes. docs/release-report.json remains correctly blocked by dirty_worktree, a non-release-eligible dirty benchmark receipt, and absent external branch-protection, remote-CI, and independent-regeneration URLs. No correctness tolerance was weakened; the coverage-only PrimitiveSuite timeout was raised to two minutes because scoverage made a 3.6s JVM test exceed MUnit's generic 30s limit. Do not close this issue until the court is rerun from a clean committed checkout and the three external evidence links are supplied.
